english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for computer-created or online substitutes, especially when the thing is simulated rather than physically present.

examples.english: We use virtual reality to view flats, so we don't have to go in person.
examples.traditional: 我哋用虛擬實境睇樓，唔使親身去。
